title: unified-rollouts-preflight-e2e-and-stability-guards-for-shadow-canary-autorollback
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Improve safety and surface-level observability for the unified rollouts autorollback workflow when using combined canary/A-B and shadow traffic modes. This PR adds a preflight E2E harness, stability guards (quorum, cooldown, hysteresis), metric matching logic for shadow vs live traffic, and improved telemetry to reduce false-positive rollbacks. Scope: rollout engine safety guards, preflight synthetic traffic job, new e2e scenarios, dashboards and alerting, small refactor to the autorollback state machine to expose probe/quarantine states. Checklist: - [x] Add preflight E2E harness that runs in CI and on-demand in staging - [x] Implement quorum-based metric aggregation for quarantine stage - [x] Add cooldown and hysteresis to rollback triggers - [x] Add metric-matching layer to avoid triggering on unrelated metric spikes from shadow traffic - [x] Add unit and integration tests + e2e scenarios - [x] Update rollout docs and release notes Testing notes: included synthetic workload generator (rollouts/tests/harness/synthetic_traffic.py) to exercise shadow probing at variable latencies and error rates. Local and CI e2e runs validated stability across 1000+ simulated requests per test. Rollout safety behavior observed: abort rollback if quorum < 3, increase quarantine window before escalating, and suppress alerts for transient blips under hysteresis thresholds.

review_comments: Daniel Kim: The quorum logic looks sane but we should document the minimum required sample size and fallback behavior when traffic is low. Can you add a small note and a unit test for traffic < quorum?

Priya Nair (author): Added tests and a comment in metric_matching.py. When traffic is below quorum we keep rollout in probing state and escalate only once quorum is met; included fallback timeout in config (probe_timeout_ms).
Elena Rodriguez: CI e2e job is flaky on the first run due to test ordering. Can we isolate the synthetic traffic generator to avoid shared state across tests?
Priya Nair: Refactored harness to use isolated temp queues and added deterministic seeds to synthetic generator. Re-ran CI matrix; flakey run resolved.

Tomás Silva: Threshold defaults look aggressive (0.5% latency delta). Recommend increasing defaults and exposing them as config. Also add telemetry labels to distinguish shadow vs live-origin metrics.
Priya Nair: Increased defaults and made thresholds configurable via rollout CRD; added telemetry tag 'traffic_origin' that travels with probe metrics.
Elena Rodriguez: Can you add a short e2e that exercises weighted A/B with shadow traffic present? We had incidents where shadow-only issues correlated with A/B false positives.
Priya Nair: Added preflight e2e scenario preflight_shadow_canary.yaml that runs weighted A/B with concurrent shadow traffic; included in CI matrix.

notes: Follow-up items: monitor rollout false-positive rate; tune defaults based on 2 weeks of staging telemetry; add a canary that ships only metric-matching improvements if instability is observed. Maintainers: rollout-service, infra-ci, observability.
